0.content: In Sparks Converging Upon the Tundra, a crowd gathers outside Zapolyarny Palace after rumours about the Seals of Life spread overnight. Belozersky is asked whether the Tsaritsa is collecting them, why, and whether ordinary people can donate. He confirms the Druzhna's donations, says donations from the public are not accepted, and refuses to explain the purpose. Hecklers ask why the Druzhna, who already fight dangerous enemies, should donate. Regrator then cuts in.
